import numpy as np
import albumentations as A

def create_augmentation_pipeline():
    pipeline = A.Compose([
        A.HorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.RandomRotate90(p=0.3),
        A.RandomBrightnessContrast(
            brightness_limit=0.2,
            contrast_limit=0.2,
            p=0.5
        )
    ])
    return pipeline

# Create a sample 100x100 RGB image
sample_image = np.random.randint(0, 256, (100, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8)

# Create and apply the pipeline
pipeline = create_augmentation_pipeline()
augmented_image = pipeline(image=sample_image)['image']

assert augmented_image.shape == sample_image.shape, "Shape mismatch!"
print(f"Original shape: {sample_image.shape}, Augmented shape: {augmented_image.shape}")
